blocks.text: MANILA – The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday cautioned House prosecutors against presenting former senator Antonio Trillanes IV, advising House prosecutors to first present the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) officer and bank officials or records that would form the basis of his testimony.
